page_title: MON 2-0 ANG | Monaco v Angers 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Substitution. Samuel Nibombe (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Denis Zakaria walks off.
90+2' Harouna Djibirin (Angers) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+1' Mika Biereth (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Pierrick Capelle (Angers) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
87' Angers can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
85' Here comes a substitution. Marius Louer (Angers) is brought on as a substitute for Lilian Raolisoa.
82' It's like he was asking for a caution. Harouna Djibirin (Angers) receives a yellow card.
81' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Florent Hanin is replaced by Jacques Ekomie (Angers).
81' Yassine Belkhdim will be replaced by Marius Courcoul (Angers).
77' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
75' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
74' Monaco force their opponents to concede a corner.
73' Ansu Fati goes off the pitch and Paris Brunner (Monaco) comes on.
73' Substitution. Mika Biereth (Monaco) on for Folarin Balogun.
70' Substitution. Harouna Djibirin (Angers) in, Goduine Koyalipou out.
69' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Louis Mouton will be replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
67' Here comes a substitution. Aladji Bamba is given a rest as he is replaced by Christian Mawissa (Monaco).
62' 2 - 0 Simon Adingra (Monaco) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
57' The ball is laid off to Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the right side of the goal and forces Oumar Pona to make a decent save.
56' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly changes the colour of the card shown to Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) to a yellow. Play continues.

55' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers), but referee Guillaume Paradis must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
53' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) receives a red card after his horrific challenge and is sent off!
51' The resulting corner from Louis Mouton (Angers) is cleared.

50' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Philipp Kohn makes a great save to stop his effort.
50' Lamine Camara (Monaco) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
47' Ansu Fati (Monaco) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Oumar Pona.
46' Half-time substitution. Sebastien Pocognoli decided to make a change. Caio Henrique is replaced by Simon Adingra (Monaco).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Oumar Pona (Angers) picks up a yellow card.
43' A cross is whipped in towards Jordan Teze (Monaco) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
41' Looks like Florent Hanin (Angers) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
40' What a big chance! Lamine Camara (Monaco) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
38' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle. Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) commits a foul after dangerous play.
33' Golden chance! Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
33' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.

32' Prosper Peter (Angers) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Philipp Kohn. This effort didn't really trouble him.
29' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
29' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
28' Jordan Teze (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
25' Prosper Peter (Angers) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
22' Jordan Lefort (Angers) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
18' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
17' Lamine Camara (Monaco) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
16' Monaco enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' Prosper Peter (Angers) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Guillaume Paradis has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
7' Goduine Koyalipou (Angers) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
3' Wout Faes (Monaco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillaume Paradis no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Angers will have the kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
